title: Masonery
description: Adds a craftable satue that is able to defend you or serve as decoration.
body:
Turn stone into a loyal ally with Masonery, a mod that introduces the Sentient Statue—a craftable guardian that brings both life and protection to your builds.

The Sentient Statue isn’t just for decoration. Once created and placed, it binds itself to its creator, becoming a dependable defender that can be customized to suit your playstyle. With a simple right-click, you can cycle through its behavior modes, giving you precise control over how it reacts to the world.

- Stance 0 – Dormant: The statue remains completely still, behaving like a normal block. It won’t respond to threats, making it perfect for aesthetic builds or safe storage areas.
- Stance 1 – Defender: The statue activates only when you’re under attack. It will target and fight back against anything that harms you, acting as your personal bodyguard.
- Stance 2 – Aggressive: The statue becomes fully active, attacking all nearby entities on sight—except for you, its master. Ideal for base defense or clearing hostile areas.
Whether you want a silent monument, a reactive protector, or an unstoppable stone warrior, Masonery lets you shape your defenses your way.
